name: read_diagnostics
description: Read bounded content-free diagnostics for the current session run, or with issues=true the grouped tool-failure issues of this conversation tree

run_id.description: Omit, leave empty, or use current for the active run; otherwise provide a known canonical run UUID from this session

issues.description: true: return this conversation's grouped tool-failure issues instead (this session, its root and sub-agents): per group tool, error kind, message template, failed calls, retries, recoveries; plus rework counts. run_id is ignored.
